7.2 Pesticide environment concentration and/or aggregated total applied toxicity
Comments: Sri Lanka's progress is demonstrated through: Quantifiable Reduction in HHP Use: Regulatory restrictions on highly hazardous pesticides including, Carbosulfan and Profenophos directly lower the aggregate toxicity of pesticides used. Pollinator Risk Assessment: Generation of localized, species-specific toxicity data (Apis cerana) to guide risk mitigation. Strong Proxy Data: Comprehensive import/use statistics and compliance monitoring provide a clear, trends-based foundation for assessing potential environmental load. Efforts on Promotion of Safe and Appropriate use of Pesticides: Implementation of JICA (SAFE) project and FAO collaborated field survey on Severely Hazardous Pesticide Formulation (SHPF) occupational causing exposure risk, targets minimized health concerns. Future Direction: Efforts like the KAPEX automation project will improve the precision of use-tracking, and partnerships for projects like 'PLEASE' will enhance understanding of post-use environmental pathways (plastic containers). Conclusion: Sri Lanka reports on Headline Indicator 7.2 primarily through applied toxicity risk management and proxy data for environmental concentration , with a clear commitment to strengthening environmental monitoring capacity and human health risk in line with national technical advancement.
